3 Days Murchison Falls Safari

Book This Tour

Overview

Murchison Falls is Uganda's largest national park and one of Africa's greatest wildlife theatres — where the Nile explodes through a 7-metre rock gap creating the world's most powerful waterfall. Game drives, boat cruises and the falls top viewpoint all await.

Tour Highlights

Game drives spotting lions, elephants, giraffes, and buffalos
Nile River boat cruise to the base of Murchison Falls
Top of the falls viewpoint hike
Morning birding (470+ species)
Chimp tracking at Kaniyo Pabidi (optional add-on)

Day-by-Day Itinerary

D1 Kampala – Murchison Falls National Park

Early morning departure heading north through Kampala suburbs and into the open savannah. Afternoon game drive spotting Uganda's largest concentration of giraffe, elephants, lions, and Nile crocodiles. Sunset at the river bank before dinner at your lodge.

D2 Game Drive, Nile Cruise & Falls Viewpoint

Dawn game drive through the parklands. After breakfast, a spectacular 2-hour boat cruise up the Nile River to the base of Murchison Falls. Afternoon hike to the top of the falls for breathtaking views of the Nile squeezing through the rock gap. Evening game drive.

D3 Morning Game Drive – Return to Kampala

Final morning game drive with the chance to spot leopards and lions. After brunch, drive back to Kampala arriving in the evening. A safari of unsurpassed natural drama.
